formula_note: evolution_score = learning_value * optionality * adaptability * knowledge_gain (each 1-5, raw product 1-625). Organism ranking (tracking-lib) folds in graph transitive-unlocks so a node that is cheap-but-foundational floats up. The point is to surface LOW near-term-ROI / HIGH future-optionality plays the priority sort buries — and to flag high-priority point-features that add little to the organism's ability to evolve.

scores.rationale: The canonical foundation — decouples writes from feed/OLAP/agent-memory read models; opens CQRS, realtime, replay, audit projections. Maximum optionality.
One dispatch layer opens EVERY external arena (storefronts, marketplaces, APIs) behind the gate — each new connector is then cheap.
Conversation/orchestration kernel is the substrate for autonomous multi-agent operation — the headline product direction.
Agents that generate + manage their own skills = a self-extending system; compounding optionality, highest learning.
Gated tool-builder lets agents construct their own internal tools — self-extension within the money gate.
Template -> running company is the replication MOAT; once built, N companies stand up cheaply — huge reach optionality.
Connects three built-but-disconnected assets (sim + strategy engine + feed) into the distinctive thesis; learning-heavy, validates the vision.
The production loop every recurring business process rides; unlocks billing/SLA/lifecycle automation downstream.
Knowledge/memory infrastructure is reused by every agent + decision; high reusable-knowledge yield.
SLEEPER: modest near-term ROI but a reusable confidence engine — property-based money invariants make every future money change safer. High evolution, low priority-sort rank.
Hierarchical rollups are prerequisite for true holding-group portfolio decisions.
Slicing GL by project/cost-center opens the whole analytics + valuation surface.
Closes the observe -> decide -> calibrate loop end-to-end; the feedback substrate.
Trust -> authority ceiling is the governance model that lets autonomy scale safely; opens earned-autonomy directions.
Evals -> trust is a learning loop: the system measures its own agents and adapts authority — high learning value.
Self-service node marketplace lets the automation surface grow without core changes.
External market truth feeding DCF/multiples grounds capital decisions in reality, not self-report.
Per-scope RLS/edge functions deepen the tenancy model; enabling for multi-tenant extension.
Gating the F3 mint both closes a risk and unlocks the whole governed-commerce arena safely.
Governed browser-computer surface opens real-world execution arenas behind the gate.
A rules DSL + enforcement makes policy itself programmable — adaptable governance.
Supply-chain scanning as a policy gate generalizes the enforcement pattern beyond money.
Cheapest high-priority item; unlocks the entire live-DB test lane (turns ~37 ignored tests real) — enabling infrastructure for all future verification.
OSINT market-intel feed; useful signal but a fairly self-contained surface.
Self-serve money-gate observability; valuable for trust, moderate evolution leverage.

Materialized KPI views; depends on the (still-unvalidated) ClickHouse bet.
Log-alert state machine + dispatch; standard observability plumbing.
Real revenue surface (29 billing caps) — high business ROI but a known suite; near-term value beats future optionality here.
Wires existing dead UI code to a real source; closes a loop, modest new optionality.
Surfaces 118 agent-knowledge caps as a profile; product glue, moderate leverage.
Speculative (a value-flow ORPHAN — no revenue path identified); learning value only if a content business model emerges.
Unblocks production but is a point capability; high necessity, bounded evolution leverage.
Cleanup of a 42.5%-blank taxonomy; improves truth quality but low optionality.
Live KPI dashboard; mostly a point feature on top of the OLAP loop.
Cmd+K navigation; nice UX leverage, little structural evolution.
HIGH priority-sort, LOW evolution: a valuable point security gate that does not expand what the organism can become.
Keyboard-first approval flow; operator efficiency, minimal structural leverage.
Consolidation cleanup; reduces debt but opens little new direction.
